text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urara, la la la! ♪ I wonder what training
will be
like today? ♪

text_block_list.name: Merchant Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Urara! Just in time! Do you mind
trying my
carrot candy?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Candy?! Really? Really?! Of course I will!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! So good! These will fly off the
shelves! I
guarantee it!

text_block_list.name: Merchant Lady
text_block_list.text:
Hoho, glad to hear it! You bring a smile
to my
face, Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, really? Then I'll sample
however much
you want me to!

text_block_list.name: Merchant Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how sweet of you! Here, let me go
bring
more.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'll have Trainer try some too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, wait! AHH! Training's about to
start!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? I can't leave the
candy, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I got it! I'll just bring some to Trainer
after! I'm
so smart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's heart is stolen by the
candy, and as
a result she ditches
today's training.
